title: Foundations of Data Science
author: Avrim Blum, John Hopcroft, Ravindran Kannan
description: The mathematical and algorithmic underpinnings of data science: high-dimensional geometry, singular value decomposition, random graphs, clustering, and machine-learning theory, aimed at readers who want to understand why the methods work.

license.name: Free author draft (later published by Cambridge University Press)
